name: moderncv fancy (blue)
description: Large name and headline right of a vertical rule, contact details in the left column, dates in a left column below. moderncv 'fancy' style, blue, 10pt, A4, serif; long links and email addresses break after '/', '.' and '@' instead of running into the margin.
